name: x402-bazaar
description: Pay-per-call API marketplace on Base with x402 Builder Codes (onchain attribution).
x402PinNote: @x402/* are pinned to an exact, matching version on purpose: they implement one payment protocol together and `npm audit fix` will happily bump a subset (it moved extensions+next to 2.20 while core/evm/fetch stayed 2.16, which broke typecheck and tests). Bump all five together, then re-verify a live settlement.
overridesNote: axios: @coinbase/x402 → @coinbase/cdp-sdk still pins axios 1.16, which carries 10 open advisories (DoS via formDataToJSON recursion, prototype-pollution gadgets, maxBodyLength/NO_PROXY bypasses). 1.18 is a semver-compatible minor. Drop the override once Coinbase ships it upstream.
